Some people regard this as a passing fashion on social media, but it has indeed helped people rediscover the city around them and has brought new energy to neglected old streets. Experts suggest that city walkers should respect residents' lives and not disturb the peace of local communities.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
items.prompt:
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate the following Chinese passage into English. The passage is about table manners in China.

在中国人的餐桌上，礼仪往往体现在细节里。长辈先动筷，客人坐在主人的右侧或上座；夹菜时要用公筷，不要把筷子插在饭里。主人会不断为客人添菜，这既是热情，也是一种含蓄的关心。客人不必把饭菜全部吃完，但应当尝一尝主人推荐的菜。用餐结束时，主人通常会把客人送到门口，说一句慢走。这些看似简单的习惯，体现了中国人重视长幼、尊重客人的传统。
items.reference: At a Chinese dinner table, good manners are often shown in small details. The elders start eating first, and guests are seated on the host's right or in the seat of honour. When taking food, people use serving chopsticks, and they never stand their chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice. The host keeps adding dishes to the guests' plates; this is both generosity and a quiet way of showing care. Guests do not have to finish everything, but they should taste the dishes the host recommends. At the end of the meal, the host usually walks the guests to the door and asks them to take care on their way home. These simple habits reflect a tradition in which age and respect for guests matter.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语六级（模拟节选）
items.prompt: 近年来，中国的博物馆数量迅速增长，越来越多的年轻人把参观博物馆当作一种休闲方式。许多博物馆借助数字技术，把珍贵文物以虚拟现实的形式呈现，使观众能够近距离欣赏那些平时无法接触的展品。与此同时，博物馆还通过社交媒体与公众互动，推出丰富多彩的教育活动。专家认为，博物馆不仅是保存历史的场所，也是连接过去与未来的桥梁。
items.reference: In recent years, the number of museums in China has grown rapidly, and more and more young people regard visiting museums as a way of spending their leisure time. Many museums use digital technology to present precious cultural relics in virtual reality, enabling visitors to appreciate at close range exhibits that are normally inaccessible. Meanwhile, museums interact with the public through social media and offer a variety of educational activities. Experts believe that museums are not only places where history is preserved but also bridges connecting the past and the future.

items.title: 2023年12月六级翻译：中国人口老龄化应对
items.prompt: 随着经济与社会的发展，中国人口结构发生了显著变化，逐渐步入老龄化社会。中国老年人口将持续增加，人口老龄化趋势将更加明显。为了应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战，国家正积极采取措施，加大对养老的支持。通过改革社会保障（social security）制度，政府不断增加社会保障经费，逐步扩大社会保障覆盖范围，使更多老年人受益。政府还鼓励各种社会团体为老年人提供服务。在政府和社会团体的共同努力下，老年人将生活得更加幸福。
items.reference: With the development of the economy and society, China's population structure has undergone significant changes, gradually entering an aging society. China's elderly population will continue to increase, and the trend of population aging will become more pronounced. In order to cope with the various challenges brought by population aging, the country is actively taking measures to increase support for elderly care. By reforming the social security system, the government has continuously increased social security funding and gradually expanded the coverage of social security, benefiting more elderly people. The government also encourages various social organizations to provide services for the elderly. With the joint efforts of the government and social organizations, the elderly will live happier lives.
keyPoints: 人口老龄化 → population aging
老龄化社会 → aging society
社会保障 → social security
养老 → elderly care
社会团体 → social organizations
覆盖范围 → coverage

items.title: 2023年12月六级翻译：养老模式多元化
items.prompt: 在中国，随着老龄化社会的到来，养老受到普遍关注。人们谈论最多的是应当采取什么样的养老模式。多数人认为，养老模式需要多元化。可以通过政府引导和社会参与，建立更多更好的养老服务机构，改进社区服务中心，鼓励居家自助养老，还可以推行家庭养老与社会养老相结合的模式。随着政府和社会对养老服务事业投入的持续增加，养老设施将不断升级，服务质量逐步改进，老年人的生活将会更加方便舒适、健康快乐。
items.reference: In China, with the arrival of an aging society, elderly care has attracted widespread attention. What people discuss most is what kind of elderly care model should be adopted. Most people believe that elderly care models need to be diversified. Through government guidance and social participation, more and better elderly care service institutions can be established, community service centers can be improved, home-based self-care for the elderly can be encouraged, and a model combining family care with social care can be promoted. As the government and society continue to increase investment in elderly care services, elderly care facilities will be continuously upgraded, service quality will gradually improve, and the lives of the elderly will become more convenient, comfortable, healthy, and happy.
keyPoints: 养老模式 → elderly care model
多元化 → diversified
养老服务机构 → elderly care service institutions
居家养老 → home-based elderly care
家庭养老 → family care
社会养老 → social care

items.title: 2023年12月六级翻译：养老服务体系建设
items.prompt: 近年来，中国老龄人口持续增长。中国政府正采取各种措施，推进养老服务体系建设，使老年人晚年生活健康幸福。全国兴建了各类养老服务机构。为了提升养老机构的服务质量，政府颁布了一系列标准，加强对养老机构的监管。许多城市为方便老年人用餐，开设了社区食堂，为他们提供价格实惠的饭菜。行动不便的老年人还能享受上门送餐服务。同时，中国还在积极探索居家和社区养老等其他养老模式，以确保所有老年人老有所养。
items.reference: In recent years, China's elderly population has continued to grow. The Chinese government is taking various measures to advance the construction of an elderly care service system, enabling the elderly to live healthy and happy lives in their later years. Various types of elderly care service institutions have been established across the country. To improve the service quality of elderly care institutions, the government has promulgated a series of standards and strengthened supervision of elderly care institutions. Many cities have opened community canteens to make it convenient for the elderly to have meals, providing them with affordable food. Elderly people with mobility difficulties can also enjoy meal delivery services. At the same time, China is actively exploring other elderly care models such as home-based and community-based care to ensure that all elderly people are well cared for.
keyPoints: 养老服务体系 → elderly care service system
养老机构 → elderly care institutions
监管 → supervision
社区食堂 → community canteens
上门送餐 → meal delivery services
老有所养 → well cared for

items.title: 2023年6月六级翻译：城市公共设施建设
items.prompt: 随着中国经济的快速发展和人们生活水平的稳步提高，城市居民对环境和生活品质的要求越来越高。中国地方政府更加注重公共设施的建设和改进，以更好地满足人们的需求。通过兴建新的广场、公园和公共绿地或对原有公共场地重新加以规划改造，许多城市为市民提供了更多休闲和社交的场所。如今，政府出资购置的健身器械和铺设的健身步道在不少城市随处可见，既明显改善了市民户外活动的条件，又使城市更加美丽。
items.reference: With the rapid development of China's economy and the steady improvement of people's living standards, urban residents have increasingly higher requirements for the environment and quality of life. Local governments in China are paying more attention to the construction and improvement of public facilities to better meet people's needs. By building new squares, parks, and public green spaces, or by re-planning and renovating existing public spaces, many cities have provided citizens with more places for leisure and social activities. Today, fitness equipment purchased by the government and fitness trails laid by the government can be seen everywhere in many cities, which has not only significantly improved the conditions for citizens' outdoor activities, but also made cities more beautiful.
keyPoints: 生活水平 → living standards
公共设施 → public facilities
公共绿地 → public green spaces
休闲和社交 → leisure and social activities
健身器械 → fitness equipment
健身步道 → fitness trails

items.title: 2023年6月六级翻译：中国文化产品走向世界
items.prompt: 近年来，越来越多的中国文化产品走向全球市场，日益受到海外消费者的青睐。随着中国对外文化贸易的快速发展，中国文化产品出口额已持续多年位居世界前列，形成了一批具有国际影响力的文化企业、产品和品牌。数据显示，中国的出版物、影视作品、网络文学与动漫作品等在海外的销售量连年攀升。中国政府出台了一系列政策鼓励和支持更多具有中国元素的优秀文化产品走出国门，扩大海外市场份额，进一步提升中国文化的世界影响力。
items.reference: In recent years, more and more Chinese cultural products have entered the global market and are increasingly favored by overseas consumers. With the rapid development of China's foreign cultural trade, China's cultural product exports have ranked among the top in the world for many consecutive years, forming a group of cultural enterprises, products, and brands with international influence. Data shows that the overseas sales of China's publications, film and television works, online literature, and animation works have been rising year after year. The Chinese government has introduced a series of policies to encourage and support more excellent cultural products with Chinese elements to go global, expand overseas market share, and further enhance the global influence of Chinese culture.
keyPoints: 文化产品 → cultural products
对外文化贸易 → foreign cultural trade
国际影响力 → international influence
影视作品 → film and television works
网络文学 → online literature
海外市场份额 → overseas market share

items.title: 2023年6月六级翻译：城市高质量发展
items.prompt: 近年来，中国城市加快发展，城市人居环境得到显著改善。许多城市努力探索中国特色的城市高质量发展之路，城市功能不断完善，治理水平明显提高。中国持续开展城市生态修复和功能修补，全面实施城镇老旧小区改造，大力推进城市园林绿化，消除污染；同时大力推进城市基础设施体系化建设，开展房屋建筑和市政设施普查以及安全隐患排查整治，努力为市民创造高品质的生活环境，让城市更美丽、更安全、更宜居。
items.reference: In recent years, China's cities have accelerated their development, and the urban living environment has been significantly improved. Many cities are striving to explore a path of high-quality urban development with Chinese characteristics, with urban functions continuously improving and governance levels significantly enhanced. China has continuously carried out urban ecological restoration and functional repair, comprehensively implemented the renovation of old urban residential areas, vigorously promoted urban landscaping and greening, and eliminated pollution. At the same time, it has vigorously promoted the systematic construction of urban infrastructure, conducted surveys of buildings and municipal facilities, and investigated and rectified potential safety hazards, striving to create a high-quality living environment for citizens and make cities more beautiful, safer, and more livable.
keyPoints: 人居环境 → living environment
高质量发展 → high-quality development
生态修复 → ecological restoration
老旧小区改造 → renovation of old residential areas
园林绿化 → landscaping and greening
宜居 → livable

items.title: 2024年12月六级翻译：北斗卫星导航系统
items.prompt: 北斗（Beidou）卫星导航系统的成功研制是中国自改革开放以来取得的一项重大科技成就。研发人员经过不懈努力，攻克了一系列技术难题，北斗系统最终实现了全球覆盖和高精度定位，使中国成为世界上少数几个独立拥有全球卫星导航系统的国家之一。北斗系统已广泛应用于交通运输、灾害救援、天气预报、公共安全等诸多领域。北斗系统现在已经在国际上得到广泛认可，开始为越来越多的国家和地区提供优质服务。
items.reference: The successful development of the Beidou Satellite Navigation System is a major scientific and technological achievement China has made since the reform and opening up. After tireless efforts, researchers overcame a series of technical difficulties, and the Beidou system ultimately achieved global coverage and high-precision positioning, making China one of the few countries in the world to independently possess a global satellite navigation system. The Beidou system has been widely applied in many fields such as transportation, disaster relief, weather forecasting, and public safety. The Beidou system has now gained wide international recognition and has begun to provide quality services to an increasing number of countries and regions.
keyPoints: 卫星导航系统 → Satellite Navigation System
高精度定位 → high-precision positioning
交通运输 → transportation
灾害救援 → disaster relief
天气预报 → weather forecasting
国际认可 → international recognition

items.title: 2024年12月六级翻译：洋山港
items.prompt: 洋山港（Yangshan Port）是上海航运中心的重要组成部分，是中国第一个深水港，也是世界上规模最大的深水港之一。经过近20年的发展，洋山港已实现高度自动化。数字技术和人工智能的使用大大减少了用工成本和碳排放。自主研发的码头管理系统可以在百公里之外对大型设备进行远程操控。洋山港看上去一片繁忙，现场却见不到人工操作，而且能够24小时不间断运作。洋山港将不断发展，为把上海建成一个全球航运中心做出更大贡献。
items.reference: Yangshan Port is an important component of Shanghai's shipping center, China's first deep-water port, and one of the largest deep-water ports in the world. After nearly 20 years of development, Yangshan Port has achieved a high degree of automation. The use of digital technology and artificial intelligence has greatly reduced labor costs and carbon emissions. The independently developed terminal management system can remotely control large equipment from hundreds of kilometers away. Yangshan Port appears to be bustling with activity, yet no manual operations can be seen on site, and it can operate continuously 24 hours a day. Yangshan Port will continue to develop and make greater contributions to building Shanghai into a global shipping center.
keyPoints: 深水港 → deep-water port
高度自动化 → high degree of automation
碳排放 → carbon emissions
码头管理系统 → terminal management system
远程操控 → remote control
全球航运中心 → global shipping center

items.title: 2024年12月六级翻译：中国航天梦
items.prompt: 遨游太空历来是中华民族的梦想。2003年，神舟五号飞船发射成功，杨利伟成为第一个飞入太空的中国宇航员。2008年，神舟七号升空，翟志刚成为中国历史上首位进行太空行走的宇航员。近年来，中国航天进入创新发展"快车道"，太空基础设施建设稳步推进，中国空间站于2022年全面建成。中国航天事业的迅速发展在中华民族的历史上写下了辉煌一页，也为人类文明进步做出了巨大贡献。未来，中国探索太空的脚步将迈得更稳、更远。
items.reference: Traveling in space has always been the dream of the Chinese nation. In 2003, the Shenzhou-5 spacecraft was successfully launched, and Yang Liwei became the first Chinese astronaut to fly into space. In 2008, Shenzhou-7 was launched, and Zhai Zhigang became the first astronaut in Chinese history to conduct a spacewalk. In recent years, China's space program has entered a "fast lane" of innovative development, with the construction of space infrastructure steadily advancing, and China's space station was fully completed in 2022. The rapid development of China's space program has written a glorious page in the history of the Chinese nation and has also made tremendous contributions to the progress of human civilization. In the future, China's steps in exploring space will be more steady and far-reaching.
keyPoints: 宇航员 → astronaut
太空行走 → spacewalk
空间站 → space station
太空基础设施 → space infrastructure
人类文明进步 → progress of human civilization
探索太空 → exploring space

items.title: 2024年6月六级翻译：中国传统婚礼
items.prompt: 中国的传统婚礼习俗历史悠久，从周朝开始就逐渐形成了一套完整的婚礼仪式，有些一直沿用至今。如今的中式婚礼习俗已有很大变化，但婚礼庆典仍然十分隆重。婚礼场地经过精心装饰，以象征喜庆（jubilance）的红色为主色调，摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件。在婚礼上，新人要拜天地（bow to Heaven and Earth），感谢父母的养育之恩，并向宾客敬茶。婚礼上的每一个环节都寄托着人们对新人的美好祝愿。
items.reference: Chinese traditional wedding customs have a long history. Starting from the Zhou Dynasty, a complete set of wedding ceremonies gradually formed, some of which are still in use today. Today's Chinese wedding customs have changed greatly, but wedding celebrations are still very grand. The wedding venue is carefully decorated, with red as the main color symbolizing jubilance, and many objects wishing the newlyweds happiness are displayed. At the wedding, the newlyweds bow to Heaven and Earth, express gratitude to their parents for raising them, and serve tea to the guests. Every aspect of the wedding carries people's best wishes for the newlyweds.
keyPoints: 传统婚礼 → traditional wedding
婚礼仪式 → wedding ceremonies
婚礼庆典 → wedding celebrations
拜天地 → bow to Heaven and Earth
养育之恩 → raising them
敬茶 → serve tea

items.title: 2024年6月六级翻译：中国竹文化
items.prompt: 中国盛产竹子，是最早开发利用竹资源的国家。竹子在中国分布广泛，品种丰富。竹子实用性强，用于生产和生活的许多方面，如筷子、桌椅的制作和桥梁、房屋的建造。中国人爱竹，自古以来就有无数文人以竹为主题，创作了绚丽多彩的文学和绘画作品。竹子主干（stem）笔直，象征正直的品格。竹子具有强大的生命力和适应能力，无论环境多么恶劣，都能够顽强生存，因而寓意坚韧不拔的精神。几千年来，竹子一直被视为中华民族品格的象征。
items.reference: China is rich in bamboo and is the first country to develop and utilize bamboo resources. Bamboo is widely distributed in China with abundant varieties. Bamboo is highly practical and is used in many aspects of production and daily life, such as making chopsticks, tables and chairs, and constructing bridges and houses. Chinese people love bamboo, and since ancient times, countless literati have created colorful literary and artistic works with bamboo as their theme. The stem of bamboo is straight, symbolizing an upright character. Bamboo has strong vitality and adaptability, and can survive tenaciously no matter how harsh the environment, thus symbolizing an indomitable spirit. For thousands of years, bamboo has been regarded as a symbol of the Chinese national character.
keyPoints: 竹资源 → bamboo resources
实用性 → practicality
文人 → literati
正直的品格 → upright character
坚韧不拔 → indomitable spirit
民族品格 → national character

items.title: 2024年6月六级翻译：中国扇文化
items.prompt: 扇子自古以来就深受中国人喜爱，但现在已不只是消暑纳凉的工具，而更多地作为艺术品供人欣赏。许多扇子造型优美、做工精良，并绘有山水、花鸟、人物等精美图案，具有很高的艺术价值。中国许多著名画家和书法家喜欢在扇子上作诗绘画，展示其艺术品味。扇子常作为礼物赠予他人，表达美好的祝福和真挚的情感。如今，扇子的实用功能已大为减弱，但作为一种文化符号和艺术形式，扇子仍然在中国传统文化中扮演着重要角色。
items.reference: Fans have been deeply loved by Chinese people since ancient times, but now they are no longer just tools for cooling off in summer, but are more often appreciated as works of art. Many fans have beautiful shapes, exquisite craftsmanship, and are painted with delicate patterns of landscapes, flowers and birds, and figures, possessing high artistic value. Many famous Chinese painters and calligraphers like to compose poems and paint on fans to showcase their artistic taste. Fans are often given as gifts to express good wishes and sincere feelings. Today, the practical function of fans has greatly diminished, but as a cultural symbol and art form, fans still play an important role in Chinese traditional culture.
keyPoints: 消暑纳凉 → cooling off in summer
艺术品 → works of art
书法家 → calligraphers
艺术品味 → artistic taste
文化符号 → cultural symbol
传统文化 → traditional culture

items.title: 2025年12月六级翻译：尊老传统
items.prompt: 尊老是中华民族的传统美德，深深植根于中国人的思想和行为中，是人们普遍遵守的行为规范和社会准则。在当今的中国，这种美德得到广泛传承。社会各界积极营造敬老助老的社会氛围。为老年人提供便利服务已成为社会共识，例如社区专门开设长者食堂，公共场所配置优先座位。政府还出台了一系列政策，为老年人的权益提供有力保障。尊老是社会和谐与发展的重要基石，有助于构建更加和谐美好的社会。
items.reference: Respecting the elderly is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation, deeply rooted in the thoughts and behaviors of Chinese people, and is a code of conduct and social norm that people generally abide by. In today's China, this virtue is widely passed down. All sectors of society actively create a social atmosphere of respecting and helping the elderly. Providing convenient services for the elderly has become a social consensus, for example, communities have specially opened canteens for the elderly, and public places are equipped with priority seats. The government has also introduced a series of policies to provide strong protection for the rights and interests of the elderly. Respecting the elderly is an important cornerstone of social harmony and development, and helps build a more harmonious and beautiful society.
keyPoints: 传统美德 → traditional virtue
行为规范 → code of conduct
社会准则 → social norm
长者食堂 → canteens for the elderly
优先座位 → priority seats
社会和谐 → social harmony

items.title: 2025年12月六级翻译：自强自立精神
items.prompt: 中华民族崇尚自强自立的精神，这一精神深植于中国文化之中，是民族生存与发展的重要支撑。改革开放以来，中国在自强自立的征程上，持续加大科研投入，在信息技术、人工智能、航天工程等领域不断取得新突破。5G网络覆盖全国，远程医疗发展迅速，电子支付的使用全球领先，嫦娥探月工程展现了航天领域引人注目的发展。自强自主精神成为推动国家现代化进程的强大动力，激励着中国人民为实现中华民族伟大复兴而不懈奋斗。
items.reference: The Chinese nation advocates the spirit of self-improvement and self-reliance, a spirit deeply rooted in Chinese culture and an important support for the nation's survival and development. Since the reform and opening up, China has continuously increased investment in scientific research on the journey of self-improvement and self-reliance, achieving new breakthroughs in fields such as information technology, artificial intelligence, and aerospace engineering. 5G networks cover the whole country, telemedicine is developing rapidly, the use of electronic payment leads the world, and the Chang'e lunar exploration project has demonstrated remarkable development in the aerospace field. The spirit of self-improvement and self-reliance has become a powerful driving force for the country's modernization process, inspiring the Chinese people to strive tirelessly for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.
keyPoints: 自强自立 → self-improvement and self-reliance
科研投入 → investment in scientific research
人工智能 → artificial intelligence
航天工程 → aerospace engineering
远程医疗 → telemedicine
中华民族伟大复兴 → great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation

items.title: 2025年12月六级翻译：节俭美德
items.prompt: 节俭（frugality）是中华民族的传统美德。在中国古代，生产力低下，先人们深知劳动成果来之不易，因而秉持节俭的理念。到了物质极大丰富的今天，中国人民依然坚持节俭的生活方式，体现了理性消费的生活理念和对劳动的尊重。近年来，中国政府持续加强节约型社会的建设，倡导"光盘行动"，减少食物浪费，提倡简约低碳的生活方式，推进资源循环利用，反对过度消费。节约型社会的建设有力推动了可持续发展，为子孙后代留下了宝贵的资源和良好的生态环境。
items.reference: Frugality is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation. In ancient China, with low productivity, ancestors knew well that the fruits of labor were hard-won, and thus adhered to the concept of frugality. Even today, when material wealth is greatly abundant, the Chinese people still insist on a frugal lifestyle, reflecting the concept of rational consumption and respect for labor. In recent years, the Chinese government has continuously strengthened the construction of a conservation-oriented society, advocating the "Clean Plate Campaign" to reduce food waste, promoting a simple and low-carbon lifestyle, advancing resource recycling, and opposing excessive consumption. The construction of a conservation-oriented society has powerfully promoted sustainable development, leaving precious resources and a good ecological environment for future generations.
keyPoints: 节俭 → frugality
劳动成果 → fruits of labor
理性消费 → rational consumption
光盘行动 → Clean Plate Campaign
资源循环利用 → resource recycling
可持续发展 → sustainable development

items.title: 2025年6月六级翻译：天宫空间站
items.prompt: 天宫空间站（Tiangong Space Station）是中国首个太空实验室，拥有110多立方米使用空间，可驻留3名航天员，在距地球表面400—450公里的轨道上运行。天宫空间站已实施180多个科学研究与应用项目，涉及空间生命科学、太空医学、空间材料科学等领域。天宫空间站的研究成果在我国得到了广泛应用，产生了显著的经济效益。例如，太空育种创造的直接经济价值已超过2000亿元。天宫空间站将继续为人类探索宇宙、造福人类作出更大贡献。
items.reference: The Tiangong Space Station is China's first space laboratory, with more than 110 cubic meters of usable space, capable of accommodating 3 astronauts, and operating in an orbit 400 to 450 kilometers above the Earth's surface. The Tiangong Space Station has implemented more than 180 scientific research and application projects, covering fields such as space life science, space medicine, and space materials science. The research results of the Tiangong Space Station have been widely applied in China, generating significant economic benefits. For example, the direct economic value created by space breeding has exceeded 200 billion yuan. The Tiangong Space Station will continue to make greater contributions to humanity's exploration of the universe and the benefit of mankind.
keyPoints: 太空实验室 → space laboratory
航天员 → astronauts
空间生命科学 → space life science
太空医学 → space medicine
太空育种 → space breeding
探索宇宙 → exploration of the universe

items.title: 2025年6月六级翻译：南水北调工程
items.prompt: 自古以来，中国的水资源北缺南丰，分布极不均衡。为了有效解决北方严重缺水问题，中国政府实施了南水北调工程（the South-to-North Water Diversion Project）。这是一项跨区域配置水资源的宏大水利工程。历经数十年的规划与筹备，工程于2002年开工建设，分为东、中、西3条线路，总长4350公里，惠及人口将超过4亿。自2014年通水以来，工程向北方调水累计已超500亿立方米，有效缓解了北方地区的水资源短缺问题，改善了沿线地区的生态环境，促进了区域经济社会的协调发展。
items.reference: Since ancient times, China's water resources have been scarce in the north and abundant in the south, with extremely uneven distribution. To effectively address the serious water shortage in the north, the Chinese government implemented the South-to-North Water Diversion Project. This is a grand water conservancy project for cross-regional allocation of water resources. After decades of planning and preparation, construction began in 2002, divided into three routes — eastern, central, and western — with a total length of 4,350 kilometers, benefiting a population of more than 400 million. Since water was first diverted in 2014, the project has transferred a cumulative total of more than 50 billion cubic meters of water to the north, effectively alleviating the water shortage in northern regions, improving the ecological environment along the routes, and promoting the coordinated development of regional economy and society.
keyPoints: 南水北调 → South-to-North Water Diversion
水资源 → water resources
水利工程 → water conservancy project
跨区域 → cross-regional
生态环境 → ecological environment
协调发展 → coordinated development

items.title: 2025年6月六级翻译：粤港澳大湾区
items.prompt: 粤港澳大湾区（Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area）具有得天独厚的地理位置，拥有完善的交通基础设施和丰富的产业资源。大湾区是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一，在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位。大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群和具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心，还将打造成适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈。随着改革开放的不断深入，大湾区的发展将为中国乃至世界经济注入新的活力。
items.reference: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area has a uniquely advantageous geographical location, with well-developed transportation infrastructure and abundant industrial resources. The Greater Bay Area is one of the most open and economically dynamic regions in China, with an important strategic position in the country's economic development. The Greater Bay Area will not only be built into a vibrant world-class urban agglomeration and an international science and technology innovation center with global influence, but will also be developed into a high-quality living circle suitable for work, shopping, and tourism. As reform and opening up continues to deepen, the development of the Greater Bay Area will inject new vitality into China's and even the world's economy.
keyPoints: 粤港澳大湾区 → Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
交通基础设施 → transportation infrastructure
经济活力 → economic vitality
城市群 → urban agglomeration
科技创新中心 → science and technology innovation center
改革开放 → reform and opening up

items.title: 中国茶文化
items.prompt: 中国是茶的故乡，饮茶的历史可以追溯到数千年前。对中国人来说，茶不仅是一种饮品，更是一种生活方式。客人进门，主人常常先奉上一杯热茶，以此表示欢迎和尊重。不同地区的人偏爱不同的茶：江南一带多喝清香的绿茶，北方人则更喜欢浓郁的花茶。近年来，不少年轻人重新走进茶馆，在忙碌的生活中寻找片刻安静。茶文化讲究慢下来、静下来，这种生活态度正被越来越多的人接受。
items.reference: China is the homeland of tea, and the history of tea drinking can be traced back thousands of years. For the Chinese, tea is not merely a beverage but a way of life. When a guest comes to the door, the host often offers a cup of hot tea first as a gesture of welcome and respect. A cup of tea also eases the conversation when strangers meet or when business is discussed, which explains why tea is served on so many social occasions. People in different regions prefer different kinds of tea: those living south of the Yangtze River tend to drink light and fragrant green tea, while northerners favour a stronger flower-scented tea. In recent years, quite a few young people have returned to tea houses, looking for a moment of quiet in their busy lives. The way tea is prepared, from warming the pot to pouring in a slow circle, has become a small ceremony in itself. Tea culture values slowing down and staying calm, and this attitude towards life is now being accepted by more and more people.
keyPoints: “茶的故乡”可译为 the homeland of tea，避免直译为 the hometown of tea。
“不仅……更是……”用 not merely... but... 结构，突出递进关系。
“客人进门”宜处理为 When a guest comes to the door 的时间状语从句。
“江南一带”译为 south of the Yangtze River，让读者明白大致地理位置。
“慢下来、静下来”用动词短语 slow down and stay calm，比堆形容词更自然。

items.title: 中国传统节日
items.prompt: 中国传统节日大多与农耕节奏和家庭团聚有关。春节是一年中最重要的节日，人们无论走得多远，都想在除夕之前赶回家吃一顿年夜饭。端午节有吃粽子、赛龙舟的习俗，人们借此祈求平安健康。中秋节则讲究赏月、吃月饼，寄托对亲人的思念。如今过节的方式在不断变化，人们用手机发祝福、在网上买年货，但团圆的心意没有变。节日让忙碌的人停下脚步，重新体会亲情的分量。
items.reference: Most traditional Chinese festivals are connected with the rhythm of farming and with family reunions. The Spring Festival is the most important festival of the year: however far people have travelled, they try to get home before New Year's Eve for a big family dinner. Customs differ from place to place: northern families make dumplings while southern families prepare rice cakes, and both are meant to bring good luck. At the Dragon Boat Festival, people eat rice dumplings and hold boat races, a custom through which they pray for health and safety. The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for admiring the full moon and eating mooncakes, which expresses people's longing for absent relatives. Today the ways of celebrating are changing: people send greetings by phone and buy New Year goods online, yet the wish to be together remains the same. Festivals make busy people slow down and feel afresh how much family ties matter.
keyPoints: “无论走得多远”用 however far 引导让步状语从句。
“赛龙舟”的固定表达是 hold boat races 或 dragon boat races。
“寄托对亲人的思念”可译为 express people's longing for absent relatives。
“团圆”“团聚”统一用 reunion，避免通篇重复 gather 一词。
末句“亲情的分量”宜意译为 how much family ties matter。

items.title: 中国书法
items.prompt: 书法是中国特有的一门艺术，它以毛笔、墨和宣纸为工具。写字看似简单，其实需要长年累月的练习。一个字的笔画、结构和气韵，往往能反映书写者的性格与修养。古人认为，练字也是修身的过程，心浮气躁时很难写出好字。今天，虽然人们很少用毛笔写字，但书法课在不少学校重新受到重视。许多家长希望孩子通过练字静下心来，也借此了解传统文化。
items.reference: Calligraphy is an art unique to China, and it uses a brush, ink and a special kind of paper as its tools. Writing characters may look simple, but in fact it demands years of steady practice. The strokes, the structure and the spirit of a single character can often reveal the writer's character and cultivation. The ancients believed that practising handwriting was also a way of cultivating the self, for it is hard to produce good writing when the mind is restless. Today, although people seldom write with a brush, calligraphy classes are regaining attention in many schools. Many parents hope that their children will calm down through practice and, at the same time, gain some understanding of traditional culture. Teachers have noticed that a quiet hour with brush and ink gives students a rare break from screens. In this sense, calligraphy survives not as a museum piece but as a living habit.
keyPoints: “特有的一门艺术”译为 an art unique to China，比 special art 准确。
“长年累月的练习”用 years of steady practice，避免直译 long years。
“笔画、结构和气韵”三个名词并列，气韵可译为 the spirit。
“修身”宜译为 cultivating the self 或 self-cultivation。
“心浮气躁”可处理为 when the mind is restless。

items.title: 中国高铁
items.prompt: 过去，中国人出远门常常要坐很久的火车，一趟旅程往往要花上一两天。如今，高速铁路把许多城市连接起来，人们的出行方式发生了很大变化。相距遥远的城市之间，坐高铁只需几个小时，不少人当天就能往返。高铁不仅方便了探亲和旅游，也让一些小城市获得了新的发展机会。沿线的车站周边逐渐形成新的商业区，年轻人不必再背井离乡就能找到工作。可以说，高铁改变了人们对距离的感受。
items.reference: In the past, when Chinese people travelled far from home, they often had to take long train journeys that lasted a day or two. Today high-speed rail connects many cities, and the way people travel has changed a great deal. Between cities that used to seem distant, a high-speed train now takes only a few hours, and many people can make the round trip within a single day. High-speed rail has made it easier not only to visit relatives and go sightseeing but also to bring new opportunities to smaller cities. Business districts are gradually taking shape around stations along the lines, and young people no longer have to leave their hometowns to find work. Tickets can be booked on a phone minutes before departure, which saves passengers a great deal of time. For students and workers alike, a journey that once meant packing for days has become as ordinary as a morning commute. In a real sense, high-speed rail has changed the way people feel about distance.
keyPoints: “出远门”意译为 travel far from home，不直译 go out far。
“往返”用 make the round trip。
“背井离乡”意译为 leave their hometowns，避免逐字直译。
“沿线的车站周边”可译为 around stations along the lines。
“改变了人们对距离的感受”宜译为 changed the way people feel about distance。

items.title: 中国电子商务
items.prompt: 如今，网上购物已经成为许多中国人日常生活的一部分。从衣服、家电到水果、蔬菜，几乎任何东西都能在手机上下单买到。电子商务带动了快递、仓储和支付等行业，也创造了大量就业机会。对消费者来说，网购最大的好处是方便和价格透明，动动手指就能比较不同店铺的商品。不过，网购也带来一些问题，比如商品质量参差不齐、包装浪费严重。正因如此，越来越多的人开始重视理性消费和绿色包装。
items.reference: Today online shopping has become part of everyday life for many Chinese people. From clothes and household appliances to fruit and vegetables, almost anything can be ordered on a phone. E-commerce has boosted related industries such as delivery, warehousing and payment, and it has created a large number of jobs. For consumers, the greatest advantages of online shopping are convenience and transparent prices: with a few taps they can compare goods from different stores. However, online shopping also brings problems, such as uneven product quality and serious packaging waste. For this reason, more and more people are paying attention to sensible spending and eco-friendly packaging. Small businesses in remote areas can now reach customers far beyond their own towns, which would have been unimaginable a generation ago. At the same time, shoppers are learning to look beyond low prices and to ask where a product comes from and how it is made.
keyPoints: “手机上下单”用 can be ordered on a phone，避免 order on the mobile phone 的生硬表达。
“带动……行业”可译为 has boosted related industries。
“价格透明”译为 transparent prices。
“参差不齐”意译为 uneven product quality，不要逐字翻译。
“理性消费”用 sensible spending 比 rational consumption 更自然。

items.title: 乡村振兴
items.prompt: 过去，许多农村的年轻人到城市打工，村里只剩下老人和孩子。近年来，随着乡村振兴战略的推进，这种状况正在慢慢改变。一些村庄修好了道路，通了网络，还建起了卫生室和文化广场。返乡的年轻人开起民宿、网店和农产品加工厂，把家乡的特产卖到了全国各地。农村的环境也越来越整洁，垃圾分类和污水治理让村庄面貌焕然一新。当然，乡村振兴不是一朝一夕的事，还需要长期的投入和耐心。
items.reference: In the past, many young people from rural areas went to cities to work, leaving only the elderly and children behind in the villages. In recent years, as the rural revitalization strategy has been carried forward, this situation has been changing. Some villages have built proper roads, gained internet access and set up clinics and cultural squares. Young people who have returned home are opening guesthouses, online shops and small factories that process farm products, selling local specialities across the country. The countryside is also becoming cleaner, as rubbish sorting and sewage treatment have given many villages a completely new look. Better roads and faster delivery services mean that fresh produce can reach city tables within a day, which brings farmers a steadier income. What matters most is not simply money but the chance for local people to build a decent life without leaving their land. Of course, rural revitalization cannot be achieved overnight; it calls for long-term investment and patience.
keyPoints: “乡村振兴”是固定译法 rural revitalization，不要译成 countryside rising。
“只剩下老人和孩子”用 leaving only the elderly and children behind。
“通了网络”不宜直译，可译为 gained internet access。
“卖到全国各地”译为 selling ... across the country。
“不是一朝一夕的事”意译为 cannot be achieved overnight。

items.title: 中华美食
items.prompt: 中国有句老话叫“民以食为天”，可见吃饭在人们心中的分量。中国地域辽阔，各地气候和物产不同，逐渐形成了风格各异的菜系。南方人喜欢米饭，北方人偏爱面食；四川菜麻辣，广东菜清淡，沿海地区则讲究海鲜的鲜美。中国菜讲究色、香、味俱全，烹饪方法也很多，蒸、炒、炖各有讲究。一顿好饭不仅要填饱肚子，还要让一家人围坐在一起，边吃边聊。可以说，美食是把中国人联系在一起的纽带。
items.reference: An old Chinese saying goes that food is the first need of the people, which shows how much weight a meal carries in Chinese minds. China is a vast country, and different climates and local products have gradually given rise to cuisines of very different styles. Southerners prefer rice while northerners favour wheat-based food; Sichuan cooking is hot and spicy, Guangdong dishes are light and fresh, and coastal regions pay special attention to the freshness of seafood. Chinese food values colour, aroma and taste at the same time, and there are many ways of cooking, each with its own rules, from steaming to stir-frying and slow stewing. A good meal is not only about filling the stomach; it is also a chance for a family to sit together, eat and talk. Many dishes are tied to a place and to a story, and tasting them is part of understanding the country. In a sense, good food is the bond that ties the Chinese people together.
keyPoints: “民以食为天”可意译为 food is the first need of the people。
“菜系”用 cuisines，不要译成 dish systems。
“色、香、味俱全”译为 values colour, aroma and taste at the same time。
“讲究”在文中多次出现，可分别处理为 pay attention to、have its own rules。
“纽带”译为 bond。

items.title: 中国教育的发展
items.prompt: 教育在中国一直被视为改变命运的重要途径。几十年来，国家大力普及义务教育，越来越多的孩子有机会走进学校。绝大多数儿童都能完成小学和初中阶段的学习，识字率大幅提高。与此同时，高等教育的规模不断扩大，上大学不再是少数人的特权。教育也面临新的挑战：城乡之间的资源差距仍然存在，学生的课业负担也引起广泛讨论。如何在公平与质量之间取得平衡，是全社会共同关心的问题。
items.reference: Education has long been seen in China as an important way to change one's fate. Over the past decades the state has worked hard to make compulsory education available, and more and more children have had the chance to go to school. Today the great majority of children complete primary and junior secondary schooling, and literacy has risen substantially. At the same time, higher education has kept expanding, so that going to university is no longer a privilege for a small number of people. Yet education also faces new challenges: the gap in resources between city and countryside remains, and the workload placed on students has aroused wide discussion. Parents still invest heavily in after-school classes, while teachers are urged to give children more time to play and think for themselves. How to strike a balance between fairness and quality is a question the whole society cares about. In the end, what matters is not only how many students enter university but how well they learn to learn.
keyPoints: “义务教育”固定译法为 compulsory education。
“改变命运”可译为 change one's fate。
“少数人的特权”译为 a privilege for a small number of people。
“课业负担”用 the workload placed on students。
“取得平衡”用 strike a balance。

items.title: 中国人的家庭观念
items.prompt: 在中国人心中，家庭始终占据着重要的位置。无论工作多忙，人们都会想办法在节假日回家看看父母。传统上，几代人同住在一个院子里并不少见，长辈帮忙照看孙辈，年轻人则负担起赡养老人的责任。随着城市化的发展，大家庭逐渐变小，但亲情的联系并没有因此中断。如今，许多人通过视频通话与远方的父母保持联系，逢年过节也会寄去礼物。对大多数中国人来说，家庭是遇到困难时最可靠的依靠。
items.reference: For the Chinese, the family has always held an important place. However busy their work may be, people try to find a way to go home and see their parents during holidays. Traditionally it was not unusual for several generations to live in the same courtyard: grandparents helped look after the grandchildren, while the younger adults took on the duty of supporting the elderly. As urbanisation has advanced, large families have gradually become smaller, but family ties have not been broken. Today many people keep in touch with parents far away through video calls and send gifts on important festivals. Even when adult children move to another city for work, they usually set aside part of their income for their parents and call them regularly. This sense of obligation is mutual, which is why family remains a source of strength rather than a burden. For most Chinese people, the family is the most reliable support when difficulties arise.
keyPoints: “几代人同住”用 several generations live in the same courtyard。
“照看孙辈”可译为 look after the grandchildren。
“赡养老人”译为 supporting the elderly，用 duty 一词体现责任。
“亲情的联系”译为 family ties。
“最可靠的依靠”可译为 the most reliable support。

items.title: 中医
items.prompt: 中医是中国传统医学的总称，已有几千年的历史。它讲究人与自然的和谐，认为身体不舒服往往是因为内部的平衡被打破了。中医看病重视“望闻问切”，医生会观察病人的气色，询问饮食和睡眠，再判断病因。治疗上，中医常用草药、针灸和推拿，副作用相对较小，适合调理慢性病。近年来，中医在海外也受到关注，一些外国医生开始学习针灸。当然，中医需要更多科学研究的支持，才能更好地被世界接受。
items.reference: Traditional Chinese medicine is the general term for China's ancient medical practice, which has a history of several thousand years. It emphasises harmony between people and nature and holds that discomfort in the body usually comes from a broken internal balance. In diagnosis a doctor attaches great importance to observing, listening, asking and feeling the pulse: he watches the patient's complexion, asks about diet and sleep, and then judges the cause of the illness. For treatment, Chinese medicine often uses herbs, acupuncture and massage, which have relatively few side effects and are well suited to adjusting to chronic complaints. In recent years it has also attracted attention overseas, and some foreign doctors have begun to study acupuncture. Many people now turn to it not as a last resort but as part of a healthy daily routine. Of course, traditional medicine needs more support from scientific research before it can be better accepted by the world.
keyPoints: “望闻问切”需意译为 observing, listening, asking and feeling the pulse。
“平衡被打破”译为 a broken internal balance。
“调理慢性病”可译为 adjusting to chronic complaints 或 treating chronic conditions。
“副作用相对较小”用 have relatively few side effects。
“几千年的历史”译为 a history of several thousand years。

items.title: 中国武术
items.prompt: 武术是中国传统的体育项目，既有实战技巧，也有强身健体的作用。练武的人讲究基本功，站桩、压腿这些动作看似枯燥，却要反复练习很多年。武术不只是打斗的技术，更强调武德，习武者要懂得克制和尊重对手。清晨的公园里，常能看到老人打太极拳，动作缓慢而连贯，呼吸与动作配合。如今，一些学校把武术列入体育课程，希望孩子在锻炼身体的同时学会专注和坚持。武术正以新的方式走进普通人的生活。
items.reference: Martial arts are a traditional Chinese sport that combines fighting skills with the building of physical strength. Practitioners pay great attention to basic skills: standing postures and leg stretches may look dull, yet they have to be repeated for years. Martial arts are not merely techniques of combat; they stress martial virtue, and a learner is expected to show restraint and respect for the opponent. In parks in the early morning, elderly people can often be seen practising tai chi, their movements slow and continuous as their breathing keeps pace with their bodies. Today some schools have added martial arts to their physical education courses, hoping that children will learn concentration and persistence while exercising. Some young people take it up for fitness, others for the calm it brings, and a few simply love the beauty of its forms. In this way martial arts are entering ordinary people's lives in new forms.
keyPoints: “强身健体”可译为 building physical strength。
“基本功”用 basic skills。
“武德”译为 martial virtue。
“克制和尊重对手”译为 show restraint and respect for the opponent。
“呼吸与动作配合”可用 as their breathing keeps pace with their bodies。

items.title: 中国传统戏曲
items.prompt: 戏曲是中国传统的舞台艺术，融合了唱、念、做、打四种表演手段。演员在台上几乎没有布景，一根马鞭可以代表骑马，一张桌子可以当作城墙。脸谱和服装也很有讲究，不同颜色暗示人物的性格，观众一看便知忠奸善恶。过去，看戏是普通人最重要的娱乐方式之一，庙会上常常挤满了人。如今，戏曲面临着观众老化的困境，年轻人对它的了解不多。为了让戏曲延续下去，一些剧团开始尝试用短视频和直播吸引新观众。
items.reference: Traditional Chinese opera is a stage art that combines singing, recitation, acting and acrobatic fighting. There is almost no scenery on the stage: a horse whip can stand for a horse, and a table can serve as a city wall. Facial make-up and costumes are also highly symbolic, since different colours hint at a character's personality, so that the audience can tell good from evil at a glance. In the past, going to the opera was one of the most important forms of entertainment for ordinary people, and temple fairs were often crowded with spectators. Today opera faces the difficulty of an ageing audience, and young people know little about it. Even so, many old artists insist that a recording can never replace the excitement of a live performance, where the audience and the actors breathe together. To keep the art alive, some companies have begun to use short videos and live streaming to attract new viewers.
keyPoints: “唱、念、做、打”需译全四项：singing, recitation, acting and acrobatic fighting。
“一根马鞭可以代表骑马”用 a horse whip can stand for a horse。
“脸谱”译为 facial make-up。
“忠奸善恶”意译为 good from evil，不必逐词对应。
“观众老化”可译为 an ageing audience。

items.title: 中国传统建筑
items.prompt: 中国传统建筑以木结构为主，讲究与自然环境的协调。北方的四合院四面围合，中间留出一个院子，既遮挡风沙，又方便家人活动。南方的民居则多依水而建，白墙黑瓦，倒映在河面上，显得格外安静。屋顶的曲线是中国建筑的一大特色，飞檐向上翘起，既实用又美观。建造房屋时，人们还会考虑风水，希望选址和朝向都能带来好运。这些老建筑不仅是居住的场所，也承载着中国人对家的理解。
items.reference: Traditional Chinese architecture is mainly built of wood and pays close attention to harmony with the natural environment. In the north, a courtyard house is enclosed on four sides with an open yard in the middle, which keeps out wind and sand and gives the family space to move about. Dwellings in the south are often built beside water; with white walls and dark tiles reflected in the river, they look especially peaceful. The curved roofline is a defining feature of Chinese building: the upturned eaves are both practical and beautiful. When a house was built, people also took feng shui into account, hoping that the site and the direction it faced would bring good fortune. Many of them have survived for centuries, and walking through their silent courtyards is like stepping into a calmer past. These old buildings are not only places to live but also carry the Chinese understanding of home.
keyPoints: “以木结构为主”译为 mainly built of wood。
“四合院”译为 courtyard house，并补充四面围合的意思。
“白墙黑瓦”用 white walls and dark tiles。
“飞檐向上翘起”译为 the upturned eaves。
“风水”可音译为 feng shui，首次出现不必强行解释。

items.title: 中国的环境保护
items.prompt: 过去几十年，中国经济快速发展，但也付出了环境代价。一些河流被污染，空气质量一度成为人们最关心的问题。近年来，情况有了明显改善。许多城市推广新能源汽车，公交和出租车逐渐换成电动车；北方的冬天减少了燃煤取暖，天空比过去蓝了很多。与此同时，植树造林和湿地保护让一些消失的鸟类重新出现。环保不只是政府的事，普通人少用一次性用品、做好垃圾分类，同样重要。
items.reference: In the past few decades China's economy has grown rapidly, but this growth has come at an environmental cost. Some rivers were polluted, and air quality once became the issue people cared about most. In recent years the situation has improved noticeably. Many cities are promoting new energy vehicles, and buses and taxis are gradually being replaced by electric ones; in the north, less coal is burned for heating in winter, and the sky is much bluer than before. At the same time, tree planting and wetland conservation have brought back some birds that had disappeared. Environmental protection is not only the government's business: for ordinary people, using fewer disposable items and sorting rubbish properly matters just as much. Cleaner air and clearer water are not luxuries but basic conditions for a decent life, and no one can afford to stand aside. Schools now teach children to save water and electricity, so that the habit starts early.
keyPoints: “付出了环境代价”译为 has come at an environmental cost。
“新能源汽车”用 new energy vehicles。
“植树造林和湿地保护”译为 tree planting and wetland conservation。
“一次性用品”译为 disposable items。
“不只是政府的事”用 not only the government's business。

items.title: 志愿服务在中国
items.prompt: 志愿服务在中国越来越普遍，参与者从大学生扩展到上班族和退休老人。社区里，志愿者帮独居老人买菜、陪他们聊天，还组织义诊和法律咨询。大型活动中，志愿者负责引导观众、维持秩序，成为城市形象的一部分。对年轻人来说，参加志愿服务既能帮助别人，也能锻炼沟通能力和责任感。有人担心，有些志愿活动流于形式，拍完照就结束了。因此，如何让志愿服务真正满足需要，而不是为了完成任务，值得思考。
items.reference: Volunteering is becoming more and more common in China, and those who take part now range from university students to office workers and retired people. In local communities, volunteers buy groceries for elderly neighbours who live alone, keep them company, and organise free medical checks and legal advice. At large events, volunteers guide the audience and keep order, and in this way they become part of a city's image. For young people, volunteering is a chance not only to help others but also to improve their communication skills and sense of responsibility. Some people worry, however, that a few activities are merely formal: a photograph is taken and then the work stops. It is therefore worth thinking about how volunteering can truly meet real needs rather than simply fulfil a task. Good organisation matters, and so does the willingness to listen to the people being helped. In the end, what counts is not the number of hours but the difference those hours make.
keyPoints: “独居老人”译为 elderly neighbours who live alone。
“义诊”可译为 free medical checks。
“维持秩序”用 keep order。
“流于形式”意译为 merely formal。
“不是为了完成任务”用 rather than simply fulfil a task。

items.title: 体育精神
items.prompt: 体育比赛最吸引人的地方，往往不是输赢，而是运动员在赛场上的精神。有人带伤坚持跑完全程，有人在对手摔倒时伸手扶起对方，这些画面比金牌更让人难忘。对普通人来说，体育运动的意义在于保持健康、释放压力。近年来，跑步、骑行和游泳在城市里流行起来，周末的公园和河边总能看到锻炼的身影。学校也越来越重视体育课，希望孩子从小养成运动的习惯。毕竟，一个健康的身体是一切的基础。
items.reference: What makes a sports competition most attractive is often not victory or defeat but the spirit athletes show on the field. Some runners finish a race despite an injury, and some players help an opponent who has fallen; such moments are more memorable than gold medals. For ordinary people, the value of sport lies in staying healthy and releasing stress. In recent years running, cycling and swimming have become popular in cities, and at weekends parks and riversides are always full of people exercising. Schools, too, are paying more attention to physical education, hoping that children will form the habit of exercise early in life. Team games teach young people to cooperate, to accept defeat gracefully and to try again after failure. It is never too late to start: a short walk every day is the simplest step towards a stronger body. Winning matters, but how you win matters more. After all, a healthy body is the foundation of everything.
keyPoints: “不是输赢，而是……”用 not ... but ... 结构。
“带伤坚持跑完全程”可译为 finish a race despite an injury。
“释放压力”用 releasing stress。
“养成运动的习惯”译为 form the habit of exercise。
“一切的基础”可译为 the foundation of everything。

items.title: 移动支付
items.prompt: 在中国的大城市里，带现金出门的人越来越少。买菜、坐地铁、交水电费，只要拿出手机扫一扫就能完成。移动支付之所以流行，一方面是因为方便，另一方面是因为它把消费记录都保存下来，方便人们查看和管理。对小商贩来说，收钱不用找零，也减少了收到假币的风险。不过，移动支付也带来新的问题，比如老年人不会使用智能手机，有时会被拒之门外。如何在便利和包容之间找到平衡，是值得关注的社会话题。
items.reference: In big Chinese cities fewer and fewer people carry cash when they go out. Buying vegetables, taking the subway or paying utility bills can all be done with a quick scan of a phone. Mobile payment has become popular partly because it is convenient and partly because it records every purchase, which makes it easy for people to check and manage their spending. For small traders, there is no change to give and less risk of accepting fake notes. However, mobile payment also creates new problems: many elderly people cannot use smartphones and are sometimes refused service. How to strike a balance between convenience and inclusiveness is a social issue that deserves attention. Some shops now keep a small amount of cash as a courtesy, and family members often help older relatives set up their phones. A payment method that excludes a whole generation is not yet a good one. Technology should make life easier for everyone, not harder for those who learn more slowly.
keyPoints: “扫一扫”译为 a quick scan of a phone。
“找零”用 change to give。
“假币”译为 fake notes。
“拒之门外”意译为 refused service，不必直译 shut out。
“便利和包容”译为 convenience and inclusiveness。

items.title: 中国旅游业的变化
items.prompt: 随着生活水平的提高，旅游已经成为许多中国家庭的固定安排。过去人们喜欢跟着旅行团走，行程紧张，常常一天要跑好几个景点。如今，自由行越来越受欢迎，人们更愿意在一个地方多住几天，慢慢感受当地的生活。乡村旅游也因此兴起，一些农家小院改造成民宿，游客可以采摘水果、体验农活。不过，热门景点在假期人满为患，环境压力不小。如何在发展和保护之间找到平衡，是旅游业必须面对的问题。
items.reference: As living standards have risen, travel has become a regular part of the year for many Chinese families. In the past people preferred package tours: the schedule was tight and they often rushed through several attractions in one day. Today independent travel is more popular, and people would rather stay longer in one place and slowly take in local life. Rural tourism has grown for the same reason: farmhouses have been turned into guesthouses where visitors can pick fruit and try farm work. However, popular destinations are badly crowded during holidays, which puts considerable pressure on the environment. More travellers now choose quieter towns and off-season trips, which eases the burden on famous sites. Local food and small souvenirs also give visitors a reason to spend money where it helps the community, and local people gain the chance to earn a living without leaving home. How to balance development and protection is a question the travel industry cannot avoid.
keyPoints: “自由行”译为 independent travel。
“人满为患”用 badly crowded。
“农家小院改造成民宿”译为 farmhouses have been turned into guesthouses。
“采摘水果、体验农活”可译为 pick fruit and try farm work。
“在发展和保护之间找到平衡”用 balance development and protection。

items.title: 中国民间手工艺
items.prompt: 中国手工艺种类繁多，木雕、刺绣、陶瓷、剪纸各有独到之处。老手艺人往往从十几岁开始学艺，一干就是几十年，手上的功夫是机器替代不了的。这些作品不仅是生活用品，也承载着地方的习俗和审美。然而，随着工业化发展，许多手工艺面临失传的危险，年轻人不愿花时间学习。近年来，一些设计师把传统纹样用在服装和家居上，让老手艺重新回到人们的视野。保护手工艺，关键是让它能养活手艺人，而不只是放进博物馆。
items.reference: Chinese folk crafts come in many forms, and wood carving, embroidery, ceramics and paper cutting each have their own merits. Old craftsmen often began learning their trade as teenagers and kept at it for decades; the skill in their hands cannot be replaced by machines. Such works are not merely daily objects but also carry local customs and tastes. However, as industry has developed, many crafts are in danger of being lost, because young people are unwilling to spend years learning them. In recent years some designers have used traditional patterns on clothing and household goods, bringing old skills back into view. Some villages have set up workshops where visitors can watch and try, and a few young people have become apprentices after discovering the craft online. To protect a craft, the key is to let it support the craftsmen, not simply put it in a museum. Every piece made by hand is slightly different, and that difference is exactly what makes it valuable.
keyPoints: “独到之处”可译为 have their own merits。
“一干就是几十年”译为 kept at it for decades。
“失传”用 in danger of being lost。
“养活手艺人”意译为 support the craftsmen。
“而不是放进博物馆”用 not simply put it in a museum。

items.title: 汉语的魅力
items.prompt: 汉语是世界上使用人数最多的语言之一。汉字由象形发展而来，笔画里包含着古人对世界的观察。同一个字声调不同，意思可能完全不同，这让初学者感到困难。汉语中有大量成语，四个字往往包含一个故事或一条道理，言简意赅。随着中国与世界的交流增多，越来越多外国人开始学习汉语，有人为了工作，有人出于兴趣。学习汉语并不容易，但每掌握一个新的表达，都会让人更接近这种语言背后的思维方式。
items.reference: Chinese is one of the most widely spoken languages in the world. Its characters developed from pictographs, and every stroke reflects how ancient people observed the world around them. The same character may mean something completely different when its tone changes, which makes learning hard for beginners. Chinese contains a large number of idioms: four characters often hold a story or a piece of wisdom, saying much in very few words. As exchanges between China and the rest of the world increase, more and more foreigners are beginning to learn Chinese, some for work and some out of interest. Characters are also a link to history: a single word can open a window onto how people lived and thought centuries ago. Learning Chinese is not easy, but every new expression mastered brings a learner closer to the way of thinking behind the language. Perhaps that is why so many learners say the language changes the way they see the world.
keyPoints: “使用人数最多”用 widely spoken，避免直译 most people use。
“象形”可译为 pictographs。
“声调”用 tone，注意与 intonation 区分。
“言简意赅”意译为 saying much in very few words。
“语言背后的思维方式”译为 the way of thinking behind the language。

items.title: 中国古典诗歌
items.prompt: 中国古典诗歌有着悠久的历史，是中华文化的重要组成部分。古人用短短几句诗，写出山水的美、离别的愁和对家乡的思念。唐诗和宋词最负盛名，许多名句至今仍被人们传诵。诗歌讲究节奏和押韵，读起来朗朗上口，即使不懂其中的典故，也能感受到语言的音乐性。今天，孩子们在课堂上背诵古诗，成年人也常在闲暇时读上几首。诗歌让忙碌的现代人有机会停下来，体会古人的情感与智慧。
items.reference: Classical Chinese poetry has a long history and is an important part of Chinese culture. With only a few lines, ancient poets captured the beauty of mountains and rivers, the sorrow of parting and the longing for home. Tang poems and Song lyrics are the most famous, and many well-known lines are still recited today. Poetry values rhythm and rhyme, so it reads smoothly aloud; even without understanding the allusions, a reader can feel the music of the language. Some lines are so familiar that they come to mind at the sight of a full moon or the sound of autumn rain. A poem can say in twenty characters what a long letter might fail to express. Today children recite old poems in class, and adults often read a few in their spare time. Poetry gives busy modern people a chance to pause and to feel the emotions and wisdom of the past. In this way the past is never really far away.
keyPoints: “悠久的历史”译为 a long history。
“离别的愁”可译为 the sorrow of parting。
“朗朗上口”意译为 reads smoothly aloud。
“典故”用 allusions。
“音乐性”可译为 the music of the language。

items.title: 中国民乐
items.prompt: 中国民族音乐历史悠久，使用的乐器种类很多，二胡、古筝、笛子和琵琶各有独特的声音。二胡的声音接近人声，拉起来如泣如诉，常用来表达思念之情。古筝的音色明亮，弹奏时手指在弦上快速移动，听起来像流水一样。过去，民乐多在庙会和节日庆典上演奏，如今音乐厅里也能听到。不少年轻人把民乐和流行音乐结合起来，创作出新的作品。这说明传统并不是一成不变的，它可以在新的时代里继续生长。
items.reference: Chinese folk music has a long history and uses a wide range of instruments, and the erhu, guzheng, dizi and pipa each have a voice of their own. The erhu sounds close to the human voice and can be played in a way that seems to weep or complain, so it is often used to express longing. The guzheng has a bright tone; when the fingers move quickly over the strings, it sounds like running water. In the past folk music was mostly performed at temple fairs and festivals, but today it can also be heard in concert halls. Many young people combine folk music with pop and create new works. A single melody can remind listeners of a place, a season or a person they have not seen for years. That may be why old tunes still move people who have never learned to play them. This shows that tradition is not fixed: it can keep growing in a new age.
keyPoints: “如泣如诉”意译为 seems to weep or complain。
“音色明亮”译为 a bright tone。
“庙会和节日庆典”可译为 temple fairs and festivals。
“结合”用 combine ... with。
“一成不变”译为 fixed。

items.title: 中国烹饪
items.prompt: 中国烹饪讲究火候和调料的搭配，同样的食材，不同的做法会带来完全不同的味道。炒菜时锅要热，油要适量，动作要快，这样蔬菜才能保持清脆。炖汤则需要小火慢煮，让食材的味道慢慢融进汤里。中国人做菜很少严格照着食谱，更多依靠经验和感觉，盐多盐少全凭口味。一家人围在厨房里择菜、切菜，边聊天边做饭，是很温馨的场景。对许多人来说，家常菜的味道就是家的味道。
items.reference: Chinese cooking pays attention to heat control and the matching of seasonings: the same ingredient can taste completely different when it is cooked in different ways. When stir-frying, the wok should be hot, the oil should be just right and the movements should be quick, so that vegetables stay crisp. Making soup, by contrast, calls for slow cooking over a low flame so that the flavours of the ingredients melt into the liquid. Chinese people seldom follow a recipe strictly; they rely more on experience and feeling, and the amount of salt depends on personal taste. A family standing in the kitchen to wash and cut vegetables, chatting while they cook, makes a warm scene. Even simple dishes can be improved by a little patience and by using fresh ingredients bought that morning, and that is the secret behind many family tables. For many people, the taste of home cooking is the taste of home itself.
keyPoints: “火候”可译为 heat control。
“调料搭配”用 the matching of seasonings。
“保持清脆”译为 stay crisp。
“小火慢煮”用 slow cooking over a low flame。
“家的味道”译为 the taste of home。

items.title: 学习历史的意义
items.prompt: 历史是一门让人了解过去的学科，也是一面镜子。通过历史，我们知道前人曾经犯过哪些错误，取得过哪些成就。一个民族如果忘记自己的历史，就很难看清未来的方向。在中国，历史教育一直受到重视，学生从小就要学习朝代更替和重要事件。不过，学历史不只是背诵年份和名字，更重要的是学会思考：为什么会发生这件事，它给后人留下了什么。今天，越来越多的人走进博物馆，愿意花时间了解文物背后的故事。
items.reference: History is a subject that helps people understand the past, and it is also a mirror. Through history we learn what mistakes earlier generations made and what they achieved. If a nation forgets its own history, it will find it hard to see clearly where it should go. In China history education has always been valued, and students learn about the rise and fall of dynasties and about important events from an early age. Learning history, however, is not just about memorising years and names; it is more important to learn to think: why did this happen, and what has it left to later generations? Today more and more people visit museums and are willing to spend time discovering the stories behind the objects on display. The past is not dead; it shapes the way we live and the choices we make. A person who understands history is less likely to be fooled by simple answers.
keyPoints: “一面镜子”译为 a mirror。
“朝代更替”用 the rise and fall of dynasties。
“不只是……更重要的是……”用 not just ... it is more important to ...。
“文物”可译为 objects on display 或 cultural relics。
“留下”可译为 left to later generations。

items.title: 城市的发展
items.prompt: 过去几十年，中国的城市发生了巨大的变化。低矮的平房变成高楼，狭窄的土路变成宽阔的马路，地铁把城市的各个角落连接起来。公园、图书馆和体育馆越来越多，居民的生活更加方便。城市发展也带来一些问题：房价上涨，交通拥堵，老城区的居民搬走后，熟悉的邻里关系消失了。如何在建设中留住城市的记忆，是许多城市正在思考的问题。好的城市不仅要有漂亮的天际线，更要有温暖的人情味。
items.reference: In the past few decades Chinese cities have changed enormously. Low houses have given way to high-rises, narrow dirt roads have become wide streets, and underground lines now link every corner of the city. Parks, libraries and sports centres have multiplied, making life more convenient for residents. Urban growth, however, has brought problems too: housing prices have climbed, traffic is often heavy, and when old residents move away from a familiar neighbourhood, the old ties disappear with them. How to keep a city's memory while it is being rebuilt is a question many cities are now considering. A city that is convenient but unfriendly is not really a good place to live. Some cities have begun to protect old streets and invite residents to share their memories, so that change does not wipe out the past. After all, a good city needs more than a beautiful skyline; it needs warmth between people.
keyPoints: “低矮的平房”可译为 low houses。
“从无到有”意译为 now link every corner，不必逐字翻译。
“交通拥堵”用 traffic is often heavy 或 traffic congestion。
“邻里关系”译为 neighbourhood ties。
“天际线”用 skyline。

items.title: 人口老龄化
items.prompt: 中国正在快速进入老龄化社会，老年人口的比例逐年上升。这一变化带来许多现实问题：养老金压力增大，养老床位紧张，照顾老人的人手不足。许多年轻人工作繁忙，只能把父母托付给护工，心里却常常感到愧疚。老年人的需求也在变化，他们不再只满足于温饱，还希望学习新知识、结交朋友、参与社会。一些社区开设了老年大学和日间照料中心，颇受欢迎。老龄化既是挑战，也是重新思考家庭责任的机会。
items.reference: China is moving quickly into an ageing society, and the share of elderly people is rising year by year. This change brings many practical problems: pressure on pensions is growing, care beds are in short supply, and there are not enough hands to look after older people. Many young people are busy with work and can only entrust their parents to paid carers, which often leaves them feeling guilty. At the same time, the needs of older people are changing: they are no longer content with enough food and warmth, but want to learn new things, make friends and keep taking part in society. Some communities have opened senior colleges and day-care centres, and these are well received. Respecting the old has long been a value in Chinese culture, yet modern life makes it harder to practise than before. An ageing population is both a challenge and a chance to rethink family responsibility.
keyPoints: “老龄化社会”译为 an ageing society。
“床位紧张”用 care beds are in short supply。
“托付给护工”可译为 entrust their parents to paid carers。
“吃饱穿暖”意译为 enough food and warmth。
“既是挑战，也是机会”用 both a challenge and a chance。

items.title: 青年与时代
items.prompt: 今天的年轻人成长在一个变化很快的时代，机会多，压力也大。他们从小被鼓励努力读书，考好学校，找一份稳定的工作。然而，现实往往比想象复杂：房价高、竞争激烈，许多人毕业后才发现，人生的路并不只有一条。有的年轻人选择去小城市生活，有的辞职去做自己喜欢的事。他们比父辈更重视个人感受，也更愿意尝试不同的可能。社会应当给年轻人更多理解和空间，让他们按照自己的节奏成长。
items.reference: Today's young people are growing up in an age of rapid change, where there are many opportunities but also great pressure. From childhood they are encouraged to study hard, enter a good school and find a stable job. Reality, however, is often more complicated than the plan: housing is expensive, competition is fierce, and many people discover after graduation that there is more than one road in life. Some young people choose to live in smaller cities, while others leave their jobs to do what they really enjoy. Compared with their parents, they care more about how they feel and are more willing to try different possibilities. This does not mean they are afraid of hard work; it means they want the work to mean something. A society that trusts its young people will be rewarded with their energy and ideas. Society should give them more understanding and space to grow at their own pace.
keyPoints: “变化很快的时代”可译为 an age of rapid change。
“人生的路并不只有一条”意译为 there is more than one road in life。
“个人感受”译为 how they feel。
“按照自己的节奏”用 at their own pace。
“理解和空间”译为 understanding and space。

items.title: 阅读的力量
items.prompt: 阅读是获取知识最方便的途径之一，也是让人安静下来的好办法。一本好书可以带人走进陌生的世界，认识不同的人，经历自己从未经历的生活。对孩子来说，阅读能培养想象力和专注力，比反复做练习更有长远的好处。然而，在手机不离手的今天，很多人已经很久没有完整读完一本书了。碎片化的信息虽然来得快，却很难留下深刻的印象。不妨每天留出半小时，关掉屏幕，安安静静地读几页书。
items.reference: Reading is one of the easiest ways to gain knowledge, and it is also a good way to calm down. A good book can take a reader into an unfamiliar world, introduce different people and allow him to live a life he has never lived. For children, reading develops imagination and concentration, and in the long run it does more good than repeating exercises. Yet today, with a phone always in hand, many people have not finished a whole book for a long time. Fragmented information arrives quickly but rarely leaves a deep impression. Books also teach us to listen to opinions we do not share, which is a skill that matters far beyond the classroom. A habit of reading built in childhood can last a lifetime. It is worth setting aside half an hour a day, turning off the screen and reading a few pages in peace. In that half hour the mind rests as much as it learns.
keyPoints: “获取知识”译为 gain knowledge。
“专注力”用 concentration。
“碎片化的信息”译为 fragmented information。
“留下深刻的印象”用 leave a deep impression。
“不妨……”可译为 It is worth ...。

items.title: 公益与慈善
items.prompt: 在中国，参与公益的人越来越多，方式也更加多样。有人定期给山区的孩子寄书和文具，有人在网上为生病的陌生人捐款，还有人利用周末去养老院做义工。这些举动看起来不大，却可能改变一个人的处境。互联网让公益变得更容易，一次转发就能让更多人看到需要帮助的信息。当然，公益也需要透明，捐款去了哪里、帮了谁，都应当让捐助者知道。当善意被认真对待，愿意伸出援手的人才会越来越多。
items.reference: More and more people in China are taking part in public welfare, and the ways of doing so have become more varied. Some regularly send books and stationery to children in mountain areas, some donate money online to strangers who are seriously ill, and others spend their weekends volunteering in nursing homes. These acts may look small, but they can change a person's situation. The internet has made charity easier: a single share can bring information about someone in need to many more eyes. Giving does not have to be about money; time and attention are often just as valuable to those who receive them. Of course, charity also needs transparency, and donors should be told where their money went and whom it helped. A society is stronger when helping others feels natural rather than exceptional. When kindness is treated seriously, more people will be willing to lend a hand.
keyPoints: “公益”可译为 public welfare。
“做义工”译为 volunteering。
“转发”用 a share。
“透明”译为 transparency。
“伸出援手”用 lend a hand。

items.title: 科技改变生活
items.prompt: 科技深刻地改变了人们的生活方式。几十年前，写信要等上好多天才能收到回信，如今一条消息几秒钟就能传到地球另一端。智能设备帮我们导航、记账、提醒日程，许多过去需要跑腿的事情，现在动动手指就能完成。科技也提高了工作效率，让人们有更多时间陪伴家人。不过，人们也越来越依赖手机，离开它就感到不安。此外，个人隐私的保护成为新的难题。科技本身没有好坏，关键在于人如何使用它。
items.reference: Technology has changed the way people live in profound ways. A few decades ago, a letter might take many days to receive a reply; today a message can reach the other side of the world in seconds. Smart devices help us navigate, keep accounts and remember appointments, and many tasks that once required a trip can now be finished with a few taps. Technology has also raised efficiency at work, giving people more time to spend with their families. However, people are also becoming more dependent on their phones and feel uneasy without them. Moreover, protecting personal privacy has become a new difficulty. The same tool that saves us time can also steal it, and the choice is ours. Learning to switch off now and then is as important as learning to use the newest device. Technology itself is neither good nor bad; what matters is how people use it.
keyPoints: “深刻地改变”用 change ... in profound ways。
“动动手指”意译为 with a few taps。
“跑腿”可译为 required a trip。
“依赖手机”译为 dependent on their phones。
“关键在于”用 what matters is ...。

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级（模拟节选）
items.prompt: Directions: Suppose your university is selecting volunteers for a reading programme at the local community library. Write a letter of application to the programme coordinator, Mr. Wang. In your letter you should: 1) state your interest in the programme; 2) describe your relevant experience; 3) explain what you can contribute. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
Dear Mr. Wang,

I am writing to apply for the volunteer position in your reading programme at the City Community Library. As a sophomore majoring in English, I have always loved reading, and I would be delighted to help more people discover that pleasure.

Last year I worked as a volunteer in our university library, where I sorted returned books and helped new students find materials. That experience taught me to be patient and organized. I also took part in a weekend story-telling activity for children, which made me realize how much difference a good book can make.

If I am chosen, I would be glad to help with book sorting, reading guidance and the children's story sessions. I could also design simple posters and promote the programme on social media.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 01
items.prompt: Directions: Some people argue that university libraries should be open to the general public, while others believe that they should serve students first. What is your opinion? Write an essay on this topic. In your essay you should: 1) state your opinion clearly; 2) give two reasons to support it; 3) suggest how the possible problems could be solved. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Some people believe that university libraries should open their doors to the public. I largely agree, provided that students' needs come first. A library is funded by society, so it seems reasonable that society should benefit from it. Adults who never went to university can use the reference collection, and retired people can attend talks or borrow books. This also helps the university build a better relationship with the town around it. However, I would not open every floor. During the exam period students need silent space, and a busy public library would make that impossible. A practical solution is to admit visitors after ten in the morning and to keep two floors for students only. Everyone gains if the building is shared with care.

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 02
items.prompt: Directions: More and more university students use AI tools to help with their studies. Some say such tools save time, while others worry that students may become too dependent on them. Write an essay on how students should use AI tools in their studies. In your essay you should: 1) describe the benefits of AI tools; 2) point out the possible risks; 3) give your advice on how to use them properly. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: AI tools are now part of everyday study, and I believe they can be helpful if they are used with care. They save time on boring tasks such as checking grammar or finding the right word, and they can explain a difficult idea in several different ways. For a student who is too shy to ask in class, that is a real advantage. The risks, however, are equally clear. A tool that writes whole paragraphs for us may weaken our own writing, and it can produce confident answers that are simply wrong. My advice is to use AI as a tutor rather than a ghost writer. Ask it to explain, to test and to criticise; do not ask it to replace your own thinking. Keep your notes and drafts in your own hand, check every fact, and treat every answer as a question to be examined rather than a truth to be copied.

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 03
items.prompt: Directions: Suppose the Students' Union is launching an environmental campaign on campus. Write a proposal to all students, explaining how students can take part in environmental protection in their daily life. In your proposal you should: 1) state the purpose of the campaign; 2) give three practical suggestions; 3) call on students to act. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
Dear fellow students,

Our Students' Union is launching a month-long environmental campaign, and we need your help. The aim is simple: to show that protecting the planet begins with the small choices we make every day on this campus.

Here are three suggestions. First, sort your waste properly. It takes ten seconds to put a bottle in the yellow bin instead of the grey one. Second, bring your own cup and bag to the canteen; campus figures show that thousands of paper cups are thrown away every week. Third, take the stairs when you are only going up two floors, which is better for your health and for energy use.

We are not asking for a perfect lifestyle, only for one new habit each. Join us this Friday in front of the library and let us make our campus greener together.

Yours,
The Students' Union

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 04
items.prompt: Directions: Some people believe that every university student should take a compulsory course in traditional culture, while others argue that such knowledge should be left to personal choice. Write an essay of 120 to 150 words on this issue. In your essay you should: 1) state your own view; 2) give two reasons for your view; 3) suggest how such a course could be taught well.
items.reference:
Should traditional culture be a compulsory course at university? I believe it should, as long as the course is well designed.

First, tradition gives students a shared frame of reference. A young person who has never read a classical poem or thought about the origin of a festival can hardly understand the literature, films and even the jokes that surround them. Second, a compulsory course reaches everybody, not only the students who are already curious. Elective classes tend to attract the same small group, while a required class gives future engineers and doctors the same starting point.

The key lies in good teaching. Instead of testing names and dates, the course should ask students to discuss why old ideas still matter today. Taught in this way, it becomes a conversation between past and present rather than a list to be memorised.

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 05
items.prompt: Directions: Suppose you took part in a volunteer activity in your community last term. Write an essay of 120 to 150 words describing the experience. In your essay you should: 1) describe what you did; 2) explain what you gained from the activity; 3) encourage your classmates to take part in similar activities.
items.reference:
Last term I spent every Saturday morning at a community centre three streets away from my university. My job sounded simple: to help serve breakfast to about forty elderly people and then clean the tables. For the first two weeks I was slow and confused. By the third Saturday, though, I knew who took sugar, who needed a chair near the window, and who simply wanted someone to sit down and listen.

What struck me most was how much the visits changed my idea of being useful. I had expected to give my time, but I received lessons in patience and in asking questions instead of giving advice. I also made friends with people whose lives are very different from mine.

If your schedule allows two hours a week, I would encourage you to sign up. The centre always needs helping hands, and you will probably come back with more than you give.

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 06
items.prompt: Directions: Cross-cultural communication has become an important skill for university students. Write an essay of 120 to 150 words on how to develop this ability. In your essay you should: 1) explain why the ability matters; 2) offer two or three practical suggestions; 3) state what you expect to gain from it.
items.reference:
Cross-cultural communication is not a talent that some people are born with; it is a set of habits that can be trained.

The first habit is to ask instead of assuming. When a classmate answers a question with silence or a smile, we can say, 'I am not sure I understood. Could you explain?' A question costs nothing, while a wrong assumption may damage a friendship for months. The second habit is to watch how people actually behave rather than how our own culture says they should. Meals, greetings and even the length of a pause differ from place to place, and noticing such details is the beginning of understanding. Finally, we should be patient with ourselves. Misunderstandings are normal, and the willingness to apologise and try again matters more than perfect grammar.

Learned in this way, communication becomes a bridge rather than a test.

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 07
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a short essay on how college students can prepare for the job market through internships. Your essay should include: 1) the importance of internships for career preparation; 2) the main difficulties students face in finding a suitable internship; 3) what you think students should do to make the most of internship opportunities. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
Internships have become an important bridge between the classroom and the workplace. A well-chosen internship allows students to test their interests, learn how an organisation really works and discover which skills they still need to develop. In a competitive job market, such experience often makes a graduate's application far more convincing.

However, many students struggle to find a suitable placement. Some positions are unpaid or badly paid, while others are far from home. Students also complain that employers prefer candidates with previous experience, which creates a frustrating circle.

In my view, students should start early and look beyond famous companies. A small firm may offer more responsibility and closer guidance. During the internship, they should keep a simple record of what they do, ask for feedback and build relationships with colleagues, because a good reference is as valuable as a line on a CV.

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 08
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a short essay on the problem of irregular daily routines among college students. Your essay should include: 1) the causes of irregular sleeping and eating habits among students; 2) the harm these habits do to health and study; 3) your suggestions for building a healthier routine. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
Many college students live on an irregular schedule. They stay up late finishing assignments or watching videos, skip breakfast, and then sleep through the weekend to catch up. The causes are not hard to find: heavy coursework, part-time jobs and the freedom to decide when to sleep all encourage delay.

The harm is easy to underestimate. Irregular sleep makes it hard to concentrate in class, weakens the immune system and increases anxiety. Students who skip breakfast often feel tired by ten in the morning and rely on coffee, which in turn keeps them awake at night.

Building a healthier routine does not require a strict timetable. In my view, students should fix a bedtime and a waking time, keep meals regular, and replace late-night phone use with a short walk or some reading. Exercise three times a week also helps. Small changes, repeated for a month, are more useful than an ambitious plan that lasts three days.

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 09
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a short essay on citywalk, a way of exploring a city on foot. Your essay should include: 1) what citywalk means and why it has become popular; 2) an experience of your own or of someone you know; 3) what you have learned from it. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
Citywalk means exploring a city on foot, usually without a fixed route or a shopping list. It has become popular because it is cheap and healthy, because it gives young people something to share online, and because it lets them see the city they actually live in rather than the one printed on a postcard.

Last spring a friend took me on a walk through the old streets near the river. Our guide had grown up in the area, and she showed us a market that had stood in the same place for sixty years, a tiny bookshop and a wall of old photographs. We walked for three hours but covered less than five kilometres.

What I learned is that a city is not only its famous buildings. The ordinary corners are where its life continues, and walking slowly is the only way to notice them.

items.title: Writing 写作
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 10
items.prompt: Directions: Suppose your university has started using delivery robots, self-service machines and other automated services on campus. Write an essay on the advantages and disadvantages of bringing robots and automation into campus life. Your essay should include: 1) examples of the changes automation has brought to your campus; 2) the benefits and the problems it creates; 3) your own view on how the university should use such technology. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
Over the past year our campus has changed in ways few of us expected. Delivery robots now cross the square with breakfast, a chatbot answers questions in the library, and course registration is handled by an algorithm. These changes bring real benefits. Meals and parcels arrive faster, the long queues outside the canteen have almost disappeared, and students with part-time jobs find it easier to save time. Automation also frees staff from repetitive work, so they can spend more energy on teaching and advising.
